A.rationale: sales-stage lift significant (4/5 methods) and P(window ROI > 1) = 100% >= 80%; design powered for sales (MDE 20% <= 20%)

B.rationale: design NOT powered for sales (MDE 39% > 20%); sales read +17.3% [+2.6%, +31.3%] is not decision-grade (a significant read from an under-powered design overstates the effect); top-funnel lift is significant but QS / rated lift alone is not a GO; keep spend flat and re-test with a design sized for sales
